question: Should OpenClaw core accept this broad default-off continuation system, including model-callable compaction and trusted cross-session delegate returns, in this PR?
rationale: The feature is not already on main and has substantial proof, but the permanent product/security boundary for model-controlled continuation, compaction, and cross-session trusted context delivery requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow and approve before merge
options.body: Require merge refresh, the status-row fix, and explicit owner/security approval of the default-off cross-session and compaction boundary before landing this PR.

options.title: Accept broad default-off surface
options.body: Land the full feature after conflicts are resolved, intentionally owning the new config, schema, plugin SDK, and session-state behavior as a core capability.

options.title: Pause for smaller slices
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of narrower PRs for self-compaction, follow-up scheduling, and cross-session delivery APIs.

recommendation.title: Narrow and approve before merge
recommendation.body: Require merge refresh, the status-row fix, and explicit owner/security approval of the default-off cross-session and compaction boundary before landing this PR.
